why: Both concern an internal dispute over whether to spare or cover neighboring artwork, and their concepts overlap in the Yeti material.

why.T3-046: The item is an internal argument over whether the neighboring Yeti may be removed or must be spared, which is the fairness-of-covering dispute rather than a simple attack or repair.

why.T3-117: The concepts register that Place is already over, with a late proposal to extend the flag and a question about telling the late proposer, satisfying marking the canvas's end.

why.T3-037: The single concept values dynamism and evolution of the place itself, a stance on what the canvas is and is worth rather than a design, group, or erasure plan.

why.T3-154: The concepts celebrate Dutch territorial size, overrun Puerto Rico, defeated darkness and Void, and colonization, which are victory claims over rival rooms and forces.

why.T3-010: The material settles borders, compromises, and going-around arrangements with named neighbours such as Goodboye, SS13, and the Yeti.
why.T3-150: It also forms named pacts and alliances to defend or fight the Void with Overwatch, Sweden, and Czechia.
why.T3-024: It includes unasked restraint and refusals to overwrite or destroy neighbouring art, such as leaving the Creeper and sparing the Czech flag.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: A single T3-010 placement would carry the border and neighbour-space deals but not the named pacts and alliances made to defend or fight the Void.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0125936 reports a pact with Overwatch and Sweden; C1471962 makes a pact to fight the Void; C0555774 celebrates friendship with Czechia, satisfying T3-150's alliance gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-150; losing the named alliance and friendship pacts, keeping only border coexistence.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-010 alone would not carry the many refusals to overwrite or destroy neighbouring art that are not settled as a border deal.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0148422 asks to put the flag behind the Yeti without overwriting it; C0717984 leaves the Creeper standing; C0948053 refuses to destroy the Czech flag, all satisfying T3-024's restraint gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-024; losing the unasked restraint toward neighbours' art.

why.T3-028: The main material announces, shares, updates, and runs scripts and bots for the flag and defenses.
why.T3-027: It also contains principled objections that scripts block creativity or violate r/place's spirit, which is an argument about their fairness.
why.T3-089: It further shows the room's own scripts blocking or erasing intended art, with calls to turn them off or update them.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-028 alone would cover running and updating scripts but not the objections that scripts are unfair or violate the spirit of r/place.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0212430 opposes scripts, C0224981 says scripts block creativity and violate r/place's principle, C1383898 contrasts bots with simply placing blocks, satisfying T3-027.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-027; losing the fairness dispute over automation.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-028 alone would not carry the finding that the room's own scripts block or erase intended work and must be stopped or updated.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0239314 says the flag-protection script blocks new art, C0691583 asks who will turn off the defense script erasing houses, C1117240 says the flag keeps being repaired while houses are built, satisfying T3-089.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-089; losing the switch-off/update response to stale scripts fighting the plan.

why.T3-046: The exchange argues whether Place is for taking projects or drawing together, which is the fairness-of-covering dispute over others' work.

why.T3-024: The material asks to leave neighbouring art standing, spare the Yeti, and avoid annexation or vandalism of Czech and other works.
why.T3-119: It also turns from expansion to repairing displaced works, including returning area and restoring previous artwork.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-024 alone would cover sparing neighbours' art but not the active turn from expansion to rebuilding the works the room displaced.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0376878 plans to return area to groups displaced, C0677045 suggests restoring previous works, C1358816 tries to save LANBox, satisfying T3-119's former-attacker repair gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-119; losing the repair of displaced neighbours' art after expansion.

why.T3-054: The material points participants to pxls.space as another pixel canvas after Place has closed.
why.T3-111: It also redirects the community after the close into Cirkeltrek and Discord, deciding how the canvas chat/community continues.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-054 alone would carry the invitation to another pixel canvas but not the social continuation of the community after Place through Cirkeltrek and Discord.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0035473 says Place is over but the community continues in Cirkeltrek and links the Discord, satisfying T3-111's repurposing/community-continuation gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-111; losing the social/community continuity beyond the canvas.

why.T3-105: The concepts archive the complete result, share the first result image, and preserve timelapse and historical records.
why.T3-057: They also remake the event as rap, a background, and a reposted song, which is canvas art in other media.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-105 alone would keep archives, screenshots and timelapses but not the remake of the work in rap, wallpaper and song.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1288579 offers a history rap as something made together, C0974258 turns the result into a background, C1179186 reposts the song, satisfying T3-057's remake-in-another-medium gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-057; losing the creative remakes and keepsakes in other media.

why.T3-162: The host invites applications, reviews art, and allocates bounded orange space to displaced groups, which is vetting requests to build.
why.T3-151: It also exchanges space for defense or upkeep, making help part of the allocation.
